directive.gatingQuestion: After repeated resolver closure attempts, does fresh primary-source verification reveal a factual contradiction between IBM's weak Q2 headline growth and its raised full-year expectations/AI positioning, or is the remaining defect stale reconciliation?
directive.whyItMatters: IBM remains routed to deep-resolver with unchanged contradiction strings after repeated closure evidence; another loop is justified only if fresh evidence changes the disposition.
directive.successCondition: Identify materially new conflicting evidence or preserve exact unavailable repeated-route evidence and stop looping.

finding: Fresh verification of IBM's Q2 release does not produce a new contradiction. IBM reported $17.2B revenue, +1% YoY, while Software grew 5%, Data 19%, Red Hat 11%, Distributed Infrastructure 37%, and legacy Transaction Processing fell 8% and Infrastructure 7%. Management raised full-year constant-currency revenue growth expectations to 4%-5% while explicitly acknowledging late-Q2 revenue headwinds. These are segment-mix and forward-expectation tensions, not mutually exclusive facts. Prior resolver evidence already closed the routed contradiction; unchanged rerouting is now a reconciliation defect, so further exception research is unavailable as a productive closure path.

evidenceVsInference.evidence: IBM Q2 revenue grew 1%; Software grew 5%, Data 19%, Red Hat 11%, Distributed Infrastructure 37%, while Transaction Processing fell 8% and Infrastructure fell 7%. IBM raised FY constant-currency revenue growth expectation to 4%-5% and acknowledged late-quarter revenue headwinds.
evidenceVsInference.inference: Portfolio-level strategic positioning and raised full-year expectations can coexist with weak quarterly headline growth when segment performance is mixed. Whether guidance is achieved is execution risk, not a present factual contradiction.

recommendedDisposition: Do not route IBM back to deep-resolver for these unchanged contradiction strings. Consume the existing resolved disposition during deterministic reconcile or preserve a conservative block outside the resolver lane.
